GuidePark1_Networked: There are three gazebos in the scene with rounded roofs. Next to Boat, there is another brown object that is half on the River and half on the green ground; this brown object is named Dock. Above Red-Roofed Gazebo, there is a structure that appears to be a pile of green cubes stacked on top of each other called Northern Platform. Another stack of green cubes is in the bottom of the scene, near the Yellow-Roofed Gazebo, called Southern Platform. A sqaure-shaped path stretches around the green park. Each of the corners of the path is also named. The one closest to Yellow-Roofed Gazebo is named Southwest Path Corner. To the left of this is the Southwest Path Corner. The corner above this, nearest to the Orange-Roofed Gazebo, is named Northwest Path Corner. The final corner , in-between the Red and Orange-Roofed Gazebos, is the Northeast Path Corner. There are a series of three brightly colored squares above the top of the path: these are called Northern Flower Patches. There is a series of four brightly colored squares below the bottom of the sqaure path: these are called Southern Flower Patches. Just below the Western Bridge, there is a brown rectangle which is named Bench. Right next to the Orange-Roofed Gazebo, there is a series of brown rectangles named Picnic Table. Directly in-between Red-Roofed Gazebo and Orange-Roofed Gazebo, there is a blue and gray structure in the middle of the path called Northern Fountain. Right below Eastern Bridge, there is a blue and gray structure in the middle of the path called Southern Fountain. Right below the River and close to the Western Bridge, there is a tall green cylindrical object named Pine Tree By the River. Right below the Bench, there is a rounded green object called Puffy Tree By the Bench. Near Southern Fountain, there is a group of rounded green spheres called Puffy Tree By the Fountain. There is a group standing on the path to the left of Picnic Table, named Northwest Huddle of People. There is a pair standing on the Southeast Path Corner called the Couple By the Yellow-Roofed Gazebo. There is a pair standing by the Northern Fountain named Couple By the Fountain.

GuidePark3_Networked: There are two gazebos in the scene with rounded, orange roofs. The one at the top of the scene is called Northern Gazebo. The one at the bottom is called Southern Gazebo. Below the Northeast Flower Patches, there are two brightly colored sqaures called Southeast Flower Patches. In the middle of the stone path to the right of Bench by Flower Patch, there is a dark green sphere named Puffy Tree in Stone Path. In the grassy patch on the upper left side of the park, there is a light brown rectangle called Bench by Lamp. A little below and to the right of the stone path beneath this bench is a light green sphere called Puffy Tree by Lamp. By the Southern Gazebo, there is a cylindrical green object named Pine Tree by Southern Gazebo. Right beside the Southern Gazebo, there is a small black cube called Trash Bin. There are small groups of avatars scattered throughout the scene. To the right of Trash Bin, there is a pair of avatars called Couple by Southern Gazebo. To the left and a little above Fountain, there is a pair named Couple by Fountain. Near the Northern Gazebo, right to the left of the stone path coming from it, there is a group of avatars called Huddle of People by Gazebo. In the middle of the grassy patch with all the flower patches, to the right of Bench by Dancers, is a group named Dancing People. The part of the stone path right above Puffy Tree by Lamp is called Northwest Dead End. The part of the stone path right below the Southern Gazebo is called Southwest Dead End. The part of the stone paths that ends in the bottom right of the park, near the Fountain, is named Southeast Dead End. To the left of this dead end, where the path turns from the center of the park to go towards the Southern Gazebo, there is a corner in the stone paths called Stone Corner.
